top_signals.title: Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says, as prospects for U.S.-Iran diplomacy appear elusive
top_signals.summary: The latest strike happened ahead of an expected meeting between Iranian and Gulf officials in Oman to sign an agreement for shipping through the strait.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: A 5% Treasury Yield Is Raising New Risks for Markets, Economy
top_signals.summary: The bond selloff has driven a key Treasury yield to the verge of 5%, worsening angst from Wall Street to Washington about the higher borrowing costs hitting the US economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Canada hopes for more cooperation with Japan via GCAP
top_signals.summary: The Canadian ambassador to Japan said that his country can contribute in the areas of aircraft, mission control systems, radar and satellite tech.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
